# IRewarder
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/stargate/IRewarder.sol)

A rewarder is connected to the staking contract and distributes rewards whenever the staking contract
updates the rewarder.


## Functions
### onUpdate

Informs the rewarder of an update in the staking contract, such as a deposit, withdraw or claim.

Emergency withdrawals draw the balance of a user to 0, and DO NOT call `onUpdate`.
The rewarder logic must keep this in mind!


```solidity
function onUpdate(IERC20 token, address user, uint256 oldStake, uint256 oldSupply, uint256 newStake) external;
```

### connect

Called by the staking contract whenever this rewarder is connected to a staking token in the staking
contract. Should only be callable once per staking token to avoid wrongful reward attribution through
reconfiguration.


```solidity
function connect(IERC20 stakingToken) external;
```

## Events
### RewarderConnected
Emitted when the rewarder is connected to a staking token.


```solidity
event RewarderConnected(IERC20 indexed stakingToken);
```

## Errors
### MultiRewarderUnauthorizedCaller
This function is only callable by the staking contract.


```solidity
error MultiRewarderUnauthorizedCaller(address caller);
```

### RewarderAlreadyConnected
The rewarder cannot be reconnected to the same staking token as it would cause wrongful reward
attribution through reconfiguration.


```solidity
error RewarderAlreadyConnected(IERC20 stakingToken);
```
